name: Candamu (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue hoist stripe bearing two columns of yellow stars, charged with a red horse outlined in black, after the cave paintings of Candamo.
history: Municipal flag of Candamu; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: blue hoist stripe with two columns of yellow stars
